status_effects.explanation: Françoise is favorably reappraised as devoted and capable through Odette's relayed praise, prompting the narrator to revise his view of her.
The narrator is granted personal access to Swann's private sanctum, staging him as newly included in previously closed, prestigious social space.
Gilberte's adoption of an affected, domineering hostess manner copied from Mme Verdurin is presented with mild narratorial irony, slightly deflating her.

appraisal_events.evidence: « On sent qu'elle vous est si dévouée, qu'elle est si bien »; j'appris par Odette que c'est tout ce que Gilberte lui avait raconté sur ma « nurse » qui leur avait donné à elle et à son mari de la sympathie pour moi.
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette relays Gilberte's approving account of Françoise's devotion and competence, and the narrator immediately revises his own opinion of her upward, confirming the praise's local force.

appraisal_events.evidence: je pénétrai aussi au coeur du Sanctuaire... Swann, avec une bienveillance infinie... me faisait entrer dans sa bibliothèque... mes petites entrées au Palais et des audiences dans la salle du trône
appraisal_events.explanation: As an in-scene participant, the narrator is admitted into the private inner sanctum of the Swann household and personally received by Swann, staged as a privileged social favor likened to a royal audience.

appraisal_events.evidence: depuis qu'elle aussi commençait à avoir un salon, elle prenait les façons de Mme Verdurin, son ton de despotisme minaudier
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator notes with mild irony that Gilberte, now hosting her own gatherings, has begun affecting Mme Verdurin's mincing, domineering manner, a slightly deflating observation on her borrowed social airs.
